title: Fix Direct Entity-to-Entity Flow
scenario: In a valid Data Flow Diagram, two External Entities cannot exchange data directly without passing through a Process. In this broken clinic diagram, Patient sends a lab request straight to Lab, bypassing "1.0 Schedule Lab Test" and leaving "D1 Lab Orders" unconnected.
goal: Remove the illegal direct flow between Patient and Lab, route the request through 1.0 Schedule Lab Test, and record the order in D1 Lab Orders.
learningObjective: Enforce the DFD rule that External Entities may only communicate through a system Process.
hints: External Entities (Patient and Lab) cannot connect directly to each other.
Delete Patient -> Lab, then route Patient -> 1.0 Schedule Lab Test -> Lab.
Also connect 1.0 Schedule Lab Test -> D1 Lab Orders so the scheduled order is persisted.
solutionExplanation: Data between External Entities must flow through a Process. Routing Patient -> 1.0 Schedule Lab Test -> Lab and saving to D1 Lab Orders fixes the violation.

solutions.description: Process-mediated external entity communication and order storage

edges.description: Process forwards lab order to Lab
